note: Labels and tool descriptions are fixed before the spike runs. Descriptions are written for this spike, not taken from registry metadata. Labels were assigned by the project author; no independent labeller reviewed them.

rules.match: The declared API is the right tool for the stated purpose.
rules.mismatch: The declared API exists in the package, but it is the wrong tool for the stated purpose. Only purpose differs, so the deterministic API check cannot catch these cases.

csv-parser.parse: Parse CSV text into a list of rows.
csv-parser.parse_file: Read a CSV file from disk and parse its rows.

colorkit.colorize: Wrap terminal text in ANSI color escape codes.

uuidkit.uuid4: Generate a random RFC 4122 version 4 UUID.

urlnorm.normalize: Normalize a URL into a canonical form.

semverx.parse: Parse a semantic version string into its components.

tinyfmt-kit.fmt.render: Render a text template with formatted values.
